This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.85/2024, registered at Police Station - Gorabazar, District Jabalpur (M.P.)
for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)N of IPC.

Applicant is in detention since 07.03.2024.
2.
As per the prosecution story, allegation against the applicant is that he has offered some adulterated drink to the prosecturix and committed sexual intercourse with the prosecutrix.
Police registered the case against the applicant under aforesaid sections and arrested the accused person.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the FIR has been lodged after 12 days of the incident.
The prosecutrix is a major lady and has deliberately suppressed the fact that she was employed in the firm of the mother of the applicant and has not disclosed her relationship with the applicant.
The applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated.
She was the consenting party.
The FSL report has also come negative.

sentences.text: 1 the case will take time, therefore, it is prayed that the applicant may be released on bail pending the trial.

4 . O n the other hand, learned counsel for the objector and State has vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of bail on the premise that the prosecutrix used to go the applicant's house to give medicine to the applicant's mother and on the date of incident, the accused took the prosecutrix in car and deliberately offered her adulterated drink and in her semi conscious state, he committed sexual intercourse with her and thereafter, he took her to the Datt hotel in night and stayed there also he committed rape with her.

It is also submitted that the prosecutrix was shocked due to the incident and therefore, did not narrate the incident to anyone and when she recovered from the shock, she filed an FIR against the applicant.
It is also submitted that the witness Laxman, the Manager of the Hotel, has stated that on 25.02.2024 the applicant came along with one lady at about 1:30 am and left at 9:00 am.
Document has been seized in this regard.

It is also submitted that the FSL was conducted after 15 days of the incident and for this reason the FSL report has come negative.
5 .

Having taken into consideration the above submissions advanced by learned counsel for the parties, and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the view that it is not a fit case in which the applicant may be released on bail.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands dismissed.

(PRAMOD KUMAR AGRAWAL) JUDGE Priya.P Aditya Sharma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50637150/
